lines.hook: Nine of the biggest EA FC 27 upgrades among players aged twenty-one or under. And the league minutes their clubs have given them, as of the twelfth of October.
items: Johan Manzambi, Aston Villa. Sixty-seven to eighty. A hundred and eighty-five minutes.
Prosper Peter, Angers. Plus fourteen. Two hundred and twenty minutes.
Arijon Ibrahimović, Augsburg. Plus fourteen. Two hundred and two.
Dayann Methalie, Sunderland. Plus fourteen. A hundred and seven.
Lennart Karl, Bayern. Plus fourteen. A hundred and thirty-one.
Jorge Salinas, Racing Santander. Plus fifteen, and six hundred and thirty-four minutes: the only one past three hundred.
Mathys Detourbet, Monaco. Plus fifteen. A hundred and nine.
Rudy Matondo, Paris FC. Plus fifteen. A hundred and seventy-four.
And the biggest jump of all: Zavier Gozo, Crystal Palace. Fifty-five to seventy-one. Twenty-eight league minutes.
lines.quote: The game rewards a season. Clubs pay for it. Then the new club decides whether to play the player, and that part the rating cannot see.
lines.close: Six of the nine changed clubs this year. The full read is on scoutgamer.com.
